mc.title: Marketing calendar
mc.sub: Everything planned across marketing in one place, day by day: campaigns, ads, message sends, the seasonal home page, festive cut-offs, blog and social posts, and your own plan lines.
mc.note: The calendar only shows. Campaigns, ads, sends and posts are started, stopped and changed on their own pages (each line links there). Only your own plan lines are written here. No price, offer, budget or send changes.
mc.offBody: Turn it on in the settings card at the bottom of this page.
mc.offAsk: Ask the owner to turn it on.

list.empty: Nothing planned in these days for this choice.

mc.undated: {n} campaigns have no start date yet, so they are not on the calendar.

plan.d: Mark a festival, a season or a sale on the calendar, for example "Eid", "Pohela Boishakh" or "Winter sale". It is only a note for you and the team; it does not start anything.
plan.title: Title (English)
plan.titleBnHelp: Optional. Shown when the admin is in Bengali.

card.d: Marketing calendar. Off as it ships.
card.readOnly: You can see these settings but not change them.
card.onHelp: Off as it ships. On, this page and the Campaigns page show the calendar.
card.daysHelp: How many days the calendar shows at a time (7 to 366).

err.STALE: Someone changed this meanwhile. Reload the page and try again.
err.SWITCHED_OFF: The marketing calendar is off. Turn it on first.
err.NOT_FOUND: This line is not there any more. Reload the page.
err.NOT_SET_ASIDE: This line is not set aside.
err.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
